folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: temporal palettes and continuity, 2026-11-04 (B352)
folds.body:
The dated proposals above remain useful alternatives. OD7/OD8, CA12 and the later fresh-life/reciprocal-return answers qualify the earlier blanket defaults: causal correction needs actual world mechanisms; a fixed point, failed self-attack, mandatory item fading, stale future knowledge or new threat is not imposed merely to preserve a story. A supported means can change or duplicate things. Ordinary save/load preserves committed outcomes; intentional cycles and retrying one command remain distinct operations. The October 24 scope change retires the older first-milestone gate, and no new timeline-wide simulator is required before the selected playable slice.

**History and storage:** the old JSON-size, diff-size and branch-count estimates are proposals, not measured capacity. A seed plus canon changes, faded milestones, interpolated stats or a regenerated ghost can preserve a useful account without preserving the actual played life. Keep chronicle, generated reconstruction, executable paused life and record-only incompatible payload distinct. Automatic saving does not authorize silently degrading a resumable life into a synopsis. Pinning a revision does not retain its absent definitions; validate the selected payload and dependencies before offering Resume. Current journey resources, real paused histories, local ownership and the eligible unused-time bank follow their respective owners rather than cloning on a branch switch.

**Import and merge:** matching identity/parent links do not establish compatible state, and different content under one ID can reflect legitimate concurrent progress, migration or different dependencies. The X1–X4 ideas need explicit conflict/admission behavior; do not silently union conflicting live histories, drop a damaged active life or treat retained opaque bytes as executable. Preserve the recoverable original while diagnosing compatibility. Atlas titles, change summaries and shared ghost metadata also follow sealed-discovery and private-save boundaries. No archive deletion, merge, implementation or export was performed in this reconciliation.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: identity, knowledge and replay, 2026-11-04 (B352)
folds.body:
G1–G9 and the source/dial tables remain a palette, not a required roster or a new system dispatch. Soul, face and habits are accepted situational recognition possibilities. Their success depends on actual perception and concealment. Similar gear, unique-item duplication, embodiment and independent personhood depend on the selected world and source; the earlier once-per-world wording is not a universal conservation law. Likewise, live guidance need not always be rare or costly, and a replay need not universally reduce learning or impose dependence.

A real retained person/history, a trace-based reconstructed combatant, a speculative future and a divinatory observation are different evidence and identity claims. Calling G8/G9 real people does not turn an incomplete log or generated future into the actual prior or future life. Define what the source produces and what can act in the world. Refused choices do not establish the player character’s suppressed desires, and fictional shadow material must come from actual in-game receipts or authored possibilities, not invented personal facts about Weibao.

“Perfect” has a stated objective, available actions and source knowledge; bounded search is not proof of a globally optimal fight. Unknown opponent information stays unknown unless the source can obtain it. Observation, understanding, skill, execution and actual granted abilities remain separate, while a source that really teaches or bestows power can do so. The old seed/transform/summary proposal regenerates a replay faithfully only with the necessary original inputs, algorithm/content versions and random state. Reload reproducibility follows CA12 and ordinary committed-save semantics, not anti-cheat hardening or a universal RNG rule. Keep forecasts and search isolated from live rewards, costs, RNG and history until an actual means admits their consequences. No fresh source-chapter, runtime replay or playable-generator verification is claimed.
